metadata.oracle_159_explanation: In Phase 11, the sequential execution loop shared the mutable UserInstance object across all policies. By the time OraclePolicy selected its slate, earlier policies had mutated user.history with fresh click events. Because OraclePolicy called get_oracle_slate() without passing cached expected values, it selected against updated repeat bonuses, while env.step() evaluated regret against pre-round cached expected values. This subtle state drift accumulated to 159.5 regret over 20,000 rounds. In Phase 11B, each policy's trajectory is strictly isolated with its own environment under Common Random Numbers, guaranteeing Oracle cumulative regret is strictly and provably 0.000 across all rounds and seeds.
